status_at_writing: Written after exploratory development on the 2021-2023 data; before any simulation or model scoring on 2024 sessions.
question: On a capped connection, does departure-risk-aware charging serve more workplace drivers fully than industry-default equal-share load balancing, and how much connection capacity does it need for the same service? What carbon/cost/peak change follows, and what does the opt-in carbon-flex mode trade?

data.sessions: Utrecht a.s.r. office parking lot, 4TU.ResearchData doi:10.4121/80ef3824-3f5d-4e45-8794-3b8791efbd13.v2, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Local Europe/Amsterdam times converted to UTC.
data.site: Rails E and M (one shared transformer per README). Weekday days with >=3 site sessions.
data.grid: Pinned NESO GB national carbon intensity and Open-Meteo ERA5 London radiation, 2025. Session day D is replayed on the GB grid day with the same weekday: 2023 +728 d, 2024 +364 d. Constructed scenario; driver behaviour is Dutch, grid is British.
data.facility: Existing synthetic campus base load, illustrative UTC tariff, 20 kWp PV (calendar forecast for decisions, radiation-derived outcome). No stationary battery.

splits.calibration: 2023-01-01 to 2023-06-30 sessions (all rails): per-level conformal shifts
splits.selection: 2023-07-01 to 2023-12-31 site days: all policy/parameter choices
splits.test: 2024-01-01 to 2024-10-02 site days: evaluated once with the frozen selection

information_boundary: At each half-hour the controller sees only cars plugged in by the slot start (arrival, requested kWh, power limit, departure-risk quantiles from that driver's sessions on earlier dates) and whether each is still connected. True departure times and future arrivals are simulator-only. Carbon decisions use the past-only seven-day seasonal median.
request_model: Requested energy = the session's real delivered energy, clipped to the as-soon-as-possible amount under whole-half-hour presence. Assumes the request is declared at plug-in.

selection_rules.service_default: Maximise mean fully-served share over caps 100,110,...,160 kW on the selection window; tie-break lower unserved energy.
selection_rules.carbon_flex: Among LP variants with served share >= equal_share served share at 150 kW on the selection window, maximise mean carbon reduction versus equal_share at 150 kW. If none qualifies, take the highest-served variant and flag it.
selection_rules.fixed: carbon_weight 0.7, peak_weight 0.2, peak_reference 60 kW, charger 11 kW, solar 20 kWp. Not tuned.

baselines: uncontrolled (full power, ignores the cap; reference only)
same service policy with population model (AI ablation)
uncertainty: Paired day-level differences with moving-block bootstrap (blocks of 5 site days, 2000 resamples, seed 42). Exploratory; no multiple-comparison correction.
limits: One site, one operator population, Dutch behaviour on GB grid days; all chargers working; 11 kW assumed unless the session shows more; requests known at plug-in; no stationary battery; modelled average-intensity exposure, not causal abatement; no hardware control.
